description: This file defines the TaskBoard React component responsible for rendering and managing multiple task lists within a task management application. It includes functionalities for editing task lists, filtering tasks, marking tasks as complete, deleting tasks, and managing tags via a modal.

methods.name: handleEditTaskList
methods.description: Sets the task list ID in state for editing the configuration of a specific task list.

methods.name: handleManageTags
methods.description: Displays the TagManager modal for managing tags.

methods.name: handleAddTaskToList
methods.description: Sets the ID of the list to which a new task will be added.

methods.name: handleCompleteListTasks
methods.description: Marks all tasks in a specific list as completed, based on the list’s filters.

methods.name: handleDeleteListCompletedTasks
methods.description: Deletes all completed tasks within a specific list, based on its filters.

methods.name: handleSaveListConfig
methods.description: Saves changes to a task list’s configuration and exits editing mode.
